name: the dialog says what the call is for in the server's words
catches: carries the reason the session gave, verbatim, or none

name: another tool's input is shown as a heading and nothing else
catches: shows another tool's input whole, as the request made it

name: the Always button is offered whether or not there is a rule to put on it
catches: offers Always only where a rule was composed

name: the rule dialog loses the line saying why the rule was asked
catches: shows why the rule was asked

name: every dialog is drawn as a rule dialog
catches: gives a call stop and a rule request their own three buttons

name: the heading says who is asking without saying which tool
catches: heads a call stop with who wants which tool

edits.to: heading: `${who} wants to use a tool`

name: the card shows the first rule and not the rest
catches: shows every rule the Always press saves, one to a line, and keeps the button's label short

name: the Always button carries the rules on its label again
catches: shows every rule the Always press saves, one to a line, and keeps the button's label short

name: the words typed in Other go back although another option is picked
catches: sends the words typed in Other only while Other is picked

name: the card names a subagent by its type alone, never by what it was started to do
catches: says which subagent made the call, in the words it was started with, first under the heading

edits.from: lines.push({ kind: "agent", text: description === null ? whose : `${whose} — “${description}”` });

name: a subagent's call with no other line is shown as nothing but the subagent
catches: says which subagent made the call, in the words it was started with, first under the heading

name: a deny default's recommended button says Allow
catches: offers two buttons: the recommended list, labelled as what it does, and Ignore

edits.from: const RECOMMENDED = { allow: "Allow", deny: "Deny", ask: "Ask every time" };
edits.to: const RECOMMENDED = { allow: "Allow", deny: "Allow", ask: "Ask every time" };

name: the card for a held rule leaves out where it stands now
catches: says where the rule stands now, between the rule and the why, and keeps the three buttons

name: a rule no list holds is said to stand somewhere
catches: says nothing of where a rule stands that no list holds

name: a removal is headed as a rule to settle
catches: heads a removal with who asks

edits.from: heading: `${who} asks you to remove a rule`,
edits.to: heading: `${who} asks you to settle a rule`,

name: the ledger's line on a removal is drawn as a line of the server's
catches: shows the rule, where it stands, the why, and the ledger's line for it

name: the lists a rule stands in are run together
catches: says so when the ledger has no line for it, and names every list a hand edit put it in

name: a default's removal card does not say it is remembered
catches: says what one of ovai's defaults is for, and that removing it is remembered

edits.from: Removing it also means ovai does not offer it again after an update.

name: Keep is labelled Cancel
catches: offers Remove and Keep, and nothing else
